summary.text: Laurence Weissbrot is the Republican candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Merrimack 16, in the November 3, 2026 general election, after advancing from the Republican primary on September 8, 2026.
Laurence Weissbrot was also the Republican candidate for the same seat in 2024, when Connie Lane, the Democratic incumbent, defeated him 59.0% to 41.0%.
